tracks.title: Pursuit
tracks.reason: Its relentless 16th-note bass and brutally simple, impactful drum programming are the target for our core groove's foundation.

tracks.title: The Becoming
tracks.reason: The stuttering, bit-crushed drum machine feel and the arrangement's dynamic shift from broken to chaotic are key structural influences.

tracks.title: Overthrow
tracks.reason: The aggressive, distorted, and percussive nature of the main monophonic synth line is the ideal timbral and rhythmic target for our 'Shard Lead'.
